title: Photo judgments for one genus (judging/out/<Genus>.json)
description: Written by the judging agent, checked and imported by tools/judging_import.py. Suggestions only: Pierre accepts or rejects them in admin.html. See judging/AGENTS.md for the meaning of each value.

genus.description: Genus name exactly as in manifest.json genera (the file name without .json).

scope.description: Growth-form pass only: photos hold just form, polyps, unsure and note, for the photos flagged form_todo.

photos.description: One entry per photo whose manifest genus is this genus. Key = photo id (manifest f).

duplicates.description: Near-identical or redundant photos (same colony, same framing). keep = the one to keep.

featured.description: Up to 3 suggested featured photos per view, best first.

add.description: Candidate photos (manifest status 'candidate') worth approving, in the view given in photos[f].view.

form.description: Exactly one IMR growth form letter from manifest.json forms (the dominant one visible in this photo), or x = form not visible. Required except for book photos.

polyps.description: Polyps, tentacles or vesicles extended in this photo. Not a growth form. Omit when false.

view.description: Colony, Closer, Corallites. Two-view genera: wide or macro only.

genus.description: Omit when the photo shows this genus. Otherwise another genus from manifest genera, 'cmp' (look-alike comparison, two genera) or 'exclude' (unusable for good).

multi.description: Another coral takes a large part of the frame or could be the answer. Omit when false.

note.description: Required when genus is set or unsure is not empty.

photo.description: Full pass: quality and view required. Growth-form pass (scope forms): only form, polyps, unsure, note.
